name: Milena's mother's journal
description: A worn journal among the old factory belongings. Press Enter to read.
readingText:
I keep seeing the same militia men outside the factory. When I leave, one of them is always watching. Yesterday I saw a uniform across the street from my room. Perhaps I am imagining it, but I no longer feel alone, even with the curtains closed.

Today the militia came to my home with two doctors. They asked about my condition: whether I still heard voices, whether I saw things that were not there, and whether I had trouble sleeping. They wanted to know when it began and if anyone else at the factory felt the same.

I asked why the militia needed to be there for a medical visit. Nobody answered. One doctor wrote down everything I said while a militiaman stood by the door. They told me to stay available for another examination.

Now every footstep on the stairs makes me stop writing. I cannot tell whether they are watching because I am ill, or whether they know something about what is happening to me.
